title: CHRONOBERG: CAPTURING LANGUAGE EVOLUTION AND TEMPORAL AWARENESS IN FOUNDATION MODELS
findings: The paper's dataset, Chronoberg, contains historical texts (1750-2000) that include expressions of religious bias, but the provided analysis does not focus specifically on religion. One example sentence, 'Religion prescribes obedience,' was classified as non-hateful by models, which aligned with its neutral valence score.
